issue.body:
I am getting this error for the simplest .bzl file. This is the same error as in issue #[1306](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/1306), which has been closed.

> /bazel_rules/war.bzl:1:2: syntax error at '\': expected expression.
> ERROR: error loading package '': Extension 'bazel_rules/war.bzl' has errors.

war.bzl file:
```
def _impl(ctx):
print("This rule does nothing")
empty = rule(implementation=_impl)
```
I actually typed the code in bzl file, so it's not the matter of Windows line endings. What am I doing wrong in my bzl file?
